hero_subtitle: An Indo-Portuguese homestay blending cultural warmth with coastal charm
about_title: A meeting of two worlds, by the Arabian sea
about_description:
Inspired by years of travel, our homestay was born from the unforgettable experiences of staying in welcoming homes, meeting incredible people, and discovering diverse cultures along the way.
These experiences inspired us to create our own space, a place where guests can feel at home while discovering the rich flavors of Goan culture and the coastal charm that makes this region so unique.
Whether you're here to unwind, explore, or simply experience coastal living, we invite you to make yourself at home and create memories of your own.
amenities_description: Choose from cozy bunk stays or comfortable private rooms, thoughtfully designed for a relaxing coastal getaway
